import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlParamPush254

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-!
Copy any literal argument register into TW and restore that register.
The generic contracts describe complete internal files and clocks. Their
premises are instruction shapes and interface equalities, not execution
assumptions. No particular AX occurrence is asserted in this module.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlCopyBack254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open ArithmeticCantor ArithmeticControlRun254 ArithmeticControlFrame254
open ArithmeticControlStep254 ArithmeticControlClear254
open ArithmeticControlPair254 ArithmeticControlParamPush254
open ArithmeticControlFetch254 (put s1Reg)
open ArithmeticControlRead254 (s2Reg)
open ArithmeticControlUnpair254 (wsReg)
open FiniteControlTable254

structure CopyBackShape where
  copy : CopyShape
  restore : MoveShape
  first_target : copy.firstIndex = twReg
  second_target : copy.secondIndex = s1Reg
  restore_source : restore.sourceIndex = s1Reg
  restore_target : restore.targetIndex = copy.sourceIndex
  join : copy.exit = restore.test

theorem source_ne_tw (c : CopyBackShape) : c.copy.sourceIndex ≠ twReg := by
  simpa only [c.first_target] using c.copy.source_ne_first

theorem source_ne_s1 (c : CopyBackShape) : c.copy.sourceIndex ≠ s1Reg := by
  simpa only [c.second_target] using c.copy.source_ne_second

section Model
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

private theorem read_put_self (file x : V) (p : Fin 9) :
    regValue (put p x file) p = x := write_at file x p

private theorem read_put_other (file x : V) (p q : Fin 9) (h : p ≠ q) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = regValue file q := write_other file x p q h

private theorem file_ext (x y : V) (h : ∀ i, regValue x i = regValue y i) : x = y := by
  rw [←file_reg x, ←file_reg y]
  exact congrArg fileValue (funext h)

private theorem read_put (p q : Fin 9) (x file : V) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = if p = q then x else regValue file q := by
  by_cases h : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact read_put_self file x p
  · simpa only [if_neg h] using read_put_other file x p q h

/-- Exact internal clock; only scratch1 must initially vanish. -/
theorem copy_back_run (c : CopyBackShape) (file : V)
    (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) :
    controlRun (7 * regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex + 2)
      (liveValue (number c.copy.test : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.restore.exit : V)
        (put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex) file) := by
  let h := regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex
  let g := put s1Reg h
    (put twReg (regValue file twReg + h) (put c.copy.sourceIndex 0 file))
  have hcopy : controlRun (4 * h + 1) (liveValue (number c.copy.test : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.restore.test : V) g := by
    simpa only [c.first_target, c.second_target, c.join, h1, zero_add, h, g]
      using copy_run c.copy file
  have hgs1 : regValue g s1Reg = h := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_self]
  have hgp : regValue g c.copy.sourceIndex = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg c.copy.sourceIndex (source_ne_s1 c).symm,
      read_put_other _ _ twReg c.copy.sourceIndex (source_ne_tw c).symm, read_put_self]
  have hf : put c.copy.sourceIndex h (put s1Reg 0 g) =
      put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex) file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    by_cases ht : i = twReg
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, source_ne_tw c, twReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hp : i = c.copy.sourceIndex
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, (source_ne_tw c).symm]
    by_cases hs : i = s1Reg
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, source_ne_s1 c, twReg, s1Reg, h1]
    simp [read_put, g, Ne.symm ht, Ne.symm hp, Ne.symm hs]
  have hrestore : controlRun (3 * h + 1)
      (liveValue (number c.restore.test : V) g) =
      liveValue (number c.restore.exit : V)
        (put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex) file) := by
    simpa only [c.restore_source, c.restore_target, hgs1, hgp, zero_add, hf]
      using move_run c.restore g
  rw [show 7 * regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex + 2 = (4 * h + 1) + (3 * h + 1) by
      dsimp only [h]; ring, controlRun_add, hcopy, hrestore]

def argumentPushFile (argument : Fin 9) (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file argument)
    (put wsReg (cantor (regValue file twReg) (regValue file wsReg)) file)

theorem argumentPushFile_other (argument i : Fin 9) (file : V)
    (ht : i ≠ twReg) (hs : i ≠ wsReg) :
    regValue (argumentPushFile argument file) i = regValue file i := by
  rw [argumentPushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg i ht.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ wsReg i hs.symm]

/-- A clean push followed by copy/restore, for any distinct argument field. -/
theorem argument_push_run (push : PushShape) (c : CopyBackShape)
    (join : push.output.exit = c.copy.test) (hw : c.copy.sourceIndex ≠ wsReg)
    (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time (liveValue (number push.first.test : V) file) =
        liveValue (number c.restore.exit : V) (argumentPushFile c.copy.sourceIndex file) := by
  let g := pushFile file
  have hg1 : regValue g s1Reg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg s1Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg s1Reg (by decide)]
    exact h1
  have hgtw : regValue g twReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg twReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hgp : regValue g c.copy.sourceIndex = regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg c.copy.sourceIndex hw.symm,
      read_put_other _ _ twReg c.copy.sourceIndex (source_ne_tw c).symm]
  have hf : put twReg (regValue g twReg + regValue g c.copy.sourceIndex) g =
      argumentPushFile c.copy.sourceIndex file := by
    rw [hgtw, hgp, zero_add]
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    by_cases ht : i = twReg
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, argumentPushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    by_cases hs : i = wsReg
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, argumentPushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    simp [read_put, g, pushFile, argumentPushFile, Ne.symm ht, Ne.symm hs]
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hp⟩ := push_run push file h1 h2
  rw [join] at hp
  have hc := copy_back_run c g hg1
  rw [hf, hgp] at hc
  refine ⟨tp + (7 * regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex + 2),
    le_trans htp (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hp, hc]

end Model
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlCopyBack254

"""Guarded generic argument copy/restore and clean-push composition.
Reuse exactly98 project providers from pinned ParamPush PASS, six cached

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlParamPush254

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-!
Copy any literal argument register into TW and restore that register.
The generic contracts describe complete internal files and clocks. Their
premises are instruction shapes and interface equalities, not execution
assumptions. No particular AX occurrence is asserted in this module.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlCopyBack254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open ArithmeticCantor ArithmeticControlRun254 ArithmeticControlFrame254
open ArithmeticControlStep254 ArithmeticControlClear254
open ArithmeticControlPair254 ArithmeticControlParamPush254
open ArithmeticControlFetch254 (put s1Reg)
open ArithmeticControlRead254 (s2Reg)
open ArithmeticControlUnpair254 (wsReg)
open FiniteControlTable254

structure CopyBackShape where
  copy : CopyShape
  restore : MoveShape
  first_target : copy.firstIndex = twReg
  second_target : copy.secondIndex = s1Reg
  restore_source : restore.sourceIndex = s1Reg
  restore_target : restore.targetIndex = copy.sourceIndex
  join : copy.exit = restore.test

theorem source_ne_tw (c : CopyBackShape) : c.copy.sourceIndex ≠ twReg := by
  simpa only [c.first_target] using c.copy.source_ne_first

theorem source_ne_s1 (c : CopyBackShape) : c.copy.sourceIndex ≠ s1Reg := by
  simpa only [c.second_target] using c.copy.source_ne_second

section Model
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

private theorem read_put_self (file x : V) (p : Fin 9) :
    regValue (put p x file) p = x := write_at file x p

private theorem read_put_other (file x : V) (p q : Fin 9) (h : p ≠ q) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = regValue file q := write_other file x p q h

private theorem file_ext (x y : V) (h : ∀ i, regValue x i = regValue y i) : x = y := by
  rw [←file_reg x, ←file_reg y]
  exact congrArg fileValue (funext h)

private theorem read_put (p q : Fin 9) (x file : V) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = if p = q then x else regValue file q := by
  by_cases h : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact read_put_self file x p
  · simpa only [if_neg h] using read_put_other file x p q h

/-- Exact internal clock; only scratch1 must initially vanish. -/
theorem copy_back_run (c : CopyBackShape) (file : V)
    (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) :
    controlRun (7 * regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex + 2)
      (liveValue (number c.copy.test : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.restore.exit : V)
        (put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex) file) := by
  let h := regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex
  let g := put s1Reg h
    (put twReg (regValue file twReg + h) (put c.copy.sourceIndex 0 file))
  have hcopy : controlRun (4 * h + 1) (liveValue (number c.copy.test : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.restore.test : V) g := by
    simpa only [c.first_target, c.second_target, c.join, h1, zero_add, h, g]
      using copy_run c.copy file
  have hgs1 : regValue g s1Reg = h := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_self]
  have hgp : regValue g c.copy.sourceIndex = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg c.copy.sourceIndex (source_ne_s1 c).symm,
      read_put_other _ _ twReg c.copy.sourceIndex (source_ne_tw c).symm, read_put_self]
  have hf : put c.copy.sourceIndex h (put s1Reg 0 g) =
      put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex) file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    by_cases ht : i = twReg
    · subst i
      dsimp only [g, h]
      rw [read_put_other _ _ c.copy.sourceIndex twReg (source_ne_tw c),
        read_put_other _ _ s1Reg twReg (by decide),
        read_put_other _ _ s1Reg twReg (by decide), read_put_self, read_put_self]
    by_cases hp : i = c.copy.sourceIndex
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, h, (source_ne_tw c).symm]
    by_cases hs : i = s1Reg
    · subst i
      rw [read_put_other _ _ c.copy.sourceIndex s1Reg (source_ne_s1 c),
        read_put_self, read_put_other _ _ twReg s1Reg (by decide), h1]
    simp [read_put, g, Ne.symm ht, Ne.symm hp, Ne.symm hs]
  have hrestore : controlRun (3 * h + 1)
      (liveValue (number c.restore.test : V) g) =
      liveValue (number c.restore.exit : V)
        (put twReg (regValue file twReg + regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex) file) := by
    simpa only [c.restore_source, c.restore_target, hgs1, hgp, zero_add, hf]
      using move_run c.restore g
  rw [show 7 * regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex + 2 = (4 * h + 1) + (3 * h + 1) by
      dsimp only [h]; ring, controlRun_add, hcopy, hrestore]

def argumentPushFile (argument : Fin 9) (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file argument)
    (put wsReg (cantor (regValue file twReg) (regValue file wsReg)) file)

theorem argumentPushFile_other (argument i : Fin 9) (file : V)
    (ht : i ≠ twReg) (hs : i ≠ wsReg) :
    regValue (argumentPushFile argument file) i = regValue file i := by
  rw [argumentPushFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg i ht.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ wsReg i hs.symm]

/-- A clean push followed by copy/restore, for any distinct argument field. -/
theorem argument_push_run (push : PushShape) (c : CopyBackShape)
    (join : push.output.exit = c.copy.test) (hw : c.copy.sourceIndex ≠ wsReg)
    (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time (liveValue (number push.first.test : V) file) =
        liveValue (number c.restore.exit : V) (argumentPushFile c.copy.sourceIndex file) := by
  let g := pushFile file
  have hg1 : regValue g s1Reg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg s1Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ twReg s1Reg (by decide)]
    exact h1
  have hgtw : regValue g twReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg twReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hgp : regValue g c.copy.sourceIndex = regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex := by
    dsimp only [g, pushFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ wsReg c.copy.sourceIndex hw.symm,
      read_put_other _ _ twReg c.copy.sourceIndex (source_ne_tw c).symm]
  have hf : put twReg (regValue g twReg + regValue g c.copy.sourceIndex) g =
      argumentPushFile c.copy.sourceIndex file := by
    rw [hgtw, hgp, zero_add]
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    by_cases ht : i = twReg
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, argumentPushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    by_cases hs : i = wsReg
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, g, pushFile, argumentPushFile, twReg, wsReg]
    simp [read_put, g, pushFile, argumentPushFile, Ne.symm ht, Ne.symm hs]
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hp⟩ := push_run push file h1 h2
  rw [join] at hp
  have hc := copy_back_run c g hg1
  rw [hf, hgp] at hc
  refine ⟨tp + (7 * regValue file c.copy.sourceIndex + 2),
    le_trans htp (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hp, hc]

end Model
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlCopyBack254

# Internal copy, restore, and argument push

[ArithmeticControlCopyBack254](../../Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/ArithmeticControlCopyBack254.lean) proves a reusable copy/restore contract over arbitrary internal IΣ₁ register files. `CopyBackShape` contains literal `CopyShape` and `MoveShape` interfaces and their register/control equalities. It has no assumed execution theorem.

`copy_back_run` requires only `S1 = 0`. It adds the original argument-register value to TW, restores that argument register, and preserves every other coordinate, including arbitrary S2. Its exact internal execution time is `7 * oldArgument + 2`. The argument is distinct from TW and S1 by the underlying copy shape.

`argument_push_run` composes a clean `PushShape` with this copy/restore suffix. It requires both scratch coordinates zero and the argument register distinct from WS. The resulting whole file changes only:

- `TW := oldArgument`;
- `WS := cantor(oldTW, oldWS)`.

The argument and all other fields remain unchanged, and the theorem supplies a positive internal execution time. This generic unit does not bind a particular AX control interval. Concrete occurrences and the complete interpreter/Enum and binary consistency comparisons remain separate obligations.

The [audit](arithmetic_control_copy_back254_audit.lean) has five named axiom probes and nine typed callers, including arbitrary model/file inputs, arbitrary other-coordinate preservation, scratch preservation, and specialization to the AC register without assuming a concrete control occurrence. The successful source/audit run took 3.048 and 2.077 seconds with zero warnings. The two register-distinctness probes use `propext` and `Quot.sound`; the remaining three use only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`.

The [verification record](results/arithmetic-control-copy-back254-verification.json) and [existing-evidence review](results/arithmetic-control-copy-back254-review.json) preserve exact inputs, raw outputs, and the fresh source object and first provider recorded before audit. The reviewer independently checked the root-authored source, the later repair, and the actual evidence; that reviewer authored the audit and original guard, which is disclosed in the record.

The first source attempt left two coordinate-preservation goals unresolved and emitted three unused-simp warnings. The successor changes only those two proof bodies to explicit read/write rewrites; all theorem statements, the exact clock, audit callers, and proof limits remain unchanged. [The history](results/arithmetic-control-copy-back254-history.json) preserves the initial failure, original source/guard, both preparations, repair and reviews, successful raw logs, and root receipts. An earlier metadata newline inspection was a false alarm: its assertions failed before mutation, and its correction remains in that history.

The guard selects 98 project providers from the exact checked ParamPush parent, five directly imported Foundation/Mathlib boundaries, the separately retained inherited `HFS.Seq` pair, and Init/Omega. ParamPush recorded its source object before audit but lacked a separate fresh-first-provider field; the guard resolves its recorded search path now without inventing historical capture. CopyBack records both before audit.

The maintained [guard](check_arithmetic_control_copy_back254.py) changes only the source, audit, and [provider-proposal](results/arithmetic-control-copy-back254-provider-proposal.json) default paths. The exact historical dependency/cache providers are prerequisites. No compiled caches are distributed and no clean-checkout dependency build is claimed. Preparation invokes no Lean or version query:

```sh
python3 -B Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/check_arithmetic_control_copy_back254.py \
  --repo "$PWD" \
  --dependency-root /path/to/the/recorded/dependency-root \
  --param-push-evidence Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-param-push254-verification.json \
  --output /tmp/fresh-copy-back-preparation \
  --prepare-only
```

After reviewing preparation, omit `--prepare-only` in a fresh output directory to run source and audit under default proof limits, one thread, a 4,096 MiB memory limit, and a shared 120-second budget.

The underlying register program is Mira-Cult's, imported from Jeff's verification; the original TMBuilder framework is Wade's. [Prog254.lean](../../Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/Prog254.lean) records the source and attribution.
